NAVIGATIONAL WARNING NO. PL 216/2026 (COASTAL)
CATEGORY: ESTABLISHMENT OF MAJOR NEW AIDS TO NAVIGATION OR SIGNIFICANT CHANGES TO EXISTING ZONES, WHEN SUCH ESTABLISHMENT OR CHANGE MIGHT BE MISLEADING TO SHIPPING
AREA: SOUTH-EASTERN BALTIC. LOCALISATION: N OF STILO. CHART INT1292.
BETWEEN 08TH AND 09TH SEP 2026 AIS BUOYS ARE TO BE ESTABLISHED IN POSITIONS: 1. BUOY SM2 DB1 AIS: 55-06,23'N 17-56,38'E 2. BUOY SM4 DB2 AIS: 55-06,08'N 17-56,89'E UNIT ENGAGED: FAIRPLAY 37 (MMSI 261002431)
TERM OF VALIDITY: FROM 07 SEP 2026, 22:00 (UTC) TO 09 SEP 2026, 21:59 (UTC)
REMARKS: SAFE BERTH REQUESTED
PROMULGATED 07 SEP 2026. HYDROGRAPHIC OFFICE OF THE POLISH NAVY, POLISH COORDINATOR OF RADIO NAVIGATIONAL WARNINGS.
